detail_totals.schedule: Schedule of Net Patient Service Revenue

notes: Entirely business-type hospital, accrual (GAAP). Receipts = revenue lines on the Statement of Revenue, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p2): operating revenue plus nonoperating revenue; interest expense (nonoperating) is listed as a disbursement. Net position beginning is as previously reported 27,700,236, with the GASB 101 adjustment -290,228 (restated 27,410,008). Patient revenue schedule (p4) lines use the Total column; the daily-services and ancillary lines plus the negative deductions sum to the printed net 17,607,301. Operating expense schedule (p5) uses the three object columns per department (Supplies and Other recorded as supplies and materials); zero cells omitted. Read pages 1-5 of 5 The p5 departmental Supplies and Other cells (total 6,036,686 excluding nondepartmental) include employee benefits 1,942,699 as well as supplies 4,093,987 (p2); kept as supplies and materials with review.
